faq_heading: Panorama Ridge houses: your questions answered

blocks.text: Draft for Jared's approval. Built only from the monthly MLS® figures (SnapStats) for houses in Panorama Ridge. No local notes, sold prices, building list or live listing feed yet; see the open items.

Panorama Ridge, Surrey: 91 houses listed at the end of October 2026 and 12 sold in the month, a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. By listings that is number 4 of 15 Surrey communities for houses.

blocks.source: Source: MLS® data from the Greater Vancouver REALTORS® and the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board, compiled by SnapStats®. Sales ratio is homes sold divided by homes listed. On the reports’ own scale under 12% is a buyers’ market, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% is a sellers’ market. With fewer than ten homes listed, one sale moves the ratio a long way, so treat it as a rough signal. Shares are this community’s count divided by the Surrey total for houses that month.

blocks.text: Listings of houses in Panorama Ridge fell from 94 in June to 91 in October (−3.2%), and 33 sold across the 5 months. In October the community held 8.8% of Surrey’s 1,033 houses listed.
Houses or condos and townhomes in Panorama Ridge?
Panorama Ridge also had 20 condos and townhomes listed and 5 sold in October, against 91 houses listed. The Panorama Ridge condos and townhomes page has those figures.

blocks.text: Panorama Ridge home prices: what sold, November 2025 to October 2026

55 houses sold in Panorama Ridge with a median price of $1,380,000 (the middle half sold between $1,195,000 and $1,727,500), taking a median of 34 days to sell at 96.3% of the last list price; 11% sold above list. They had a median $462 per square foot, a median year built of 1990 and a median lot of 7,109 square feet.

faq.q: How many houses are for sale in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: At the end of October 2026 the Fraser Valley Real Estate Board figures showed 91 houses listed in Panorama Ridge. That is a month-end count and it moves daily; ask Jared what is on the market today.

faq.q: Is Panorama Ridge a buyers’ or sellers’ market for houses?
faq.a: In October 2026, houses in Panorama Ridge had a sales ratio of 13%, which the reports’ scale reads as a balanced market. On the reports’ scale under 12% favours buyers, 12% to 20% is balanced and over 20% favours sellers.

faq.q: How many houses sold in Panorama Ridge from June to October 2026?
faq.a: 33 houses sold in Panorama Ridge over those 5 months, out of 464 in all of Surrey.

faq.q: Does this page include townhomes or duplexes in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: No. The figures are for detached houses only. Condos and townhomes are counted on their own page.

faq.q: What did houses in Panorama Ridge sell for?
faq.a: 55 houses sold in Panorama Ridge between November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026, with a median price of $1,380,000.

faq.q: How long do houses take to sell in Panorama Ridge?
faq.a: The median was 34 days from listing to sale, and homes sold at a median 96.3% of the last list price (11% sold above list), for sales November 1, 2025 to October 22, 2026.
